data.narrative:
Planet Labs is a publicly traded space and aerospace company that has raised over $700M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 3 same-sector, same-stage public comparables: Rocket Lab ($40.0B), Firefly Aerospace ($2.9B), and Astroscale ($840M). A broader public-comp universe spans 5 additional tickers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) with a sector P/S median of 27.4x, though application is limited by unavailable revenue data.

The peer-median method is the primary applicable triangulation approach. The median valuation across the three same-stage space and aerospace peers is $2.9B, with a range spanning $840M to $40.0B. This wide dispersion reflects material differences in business model maturity and market positioning within the sector. The P/S anchoring approach, while standard for the public aerospace sector, cannot be applied to this target given the absence of disclosed revenue figures.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $2.5B (low) to $3.3B (high), centered on the peer median of $2.9B. The current market valuation of $7.56B sits materially above this range, suggesting either: (i) market pricing reflects growth trajectory or strategic assets not captured in peer comparables, or (ii) a valuation premium specific to Planet Labs' market position. Key uncertainties include revenue scale relative to peers and the degree to which satellite imagery demand supports sector-wide multiples.
